title: no prediction lines on watch with aaps-client
symptom: No prediction lines in CGM graph on watchface with aaps-client. Tested on AAPS master/client version 3.3.2.0 with Suunto 7 and Samsung Watch. On both apps on the phone prediction lines are present.
cause: The issue was not fully diagnosed in the thread, but it was acknowledged as an issue and fixed in dev with commit 7011790.
